invariants.rationale: The method acts upon TiledMap; it is likely assumed non-null.
Layers are added to parentLayers; it must be non-null for this to succeed.
element.getName() and element methods are always called, so element is assumed to be non-null.
tmxFile is passed to layer loading routines and is expected to be non-null.
imageResolver is passed to other methods and is likely assumed non-null.
